item.title: Indians Shine In First Round Of Qualifying At The ITF W35 Kalaburagi
item.description: Aakruti Sonkusare Narayan Sonkusare: The Indian contingent witnessed a highly encouraging start at the ITF W35 Kalaburagi today, as Indian players delivered a wave of strong performances on the opening day of qualifying at the Chandrashekhar Patil Stadium in Kalaburagi.

item.title: Shai Hope Admits West Indies Fell Short as India Knock Them Out of T20 World Cup Semifinal Race
item.description: West Indies captain Shai Hope conceded his side missed key moments after India chased down 195 at Eden Gardens, with Sanju Samson’s unbeaten 97 ending Windies’ T20 World Cup semifinal hopes.

item.title: Jindal Polo Estate Cup: Panther Finishes As Runners Up As Team X Lifts Trophy
item.description: Jindal Polo Estate Cup: It was an assured performance from Team X, who edged past Jindal Panther 9.5–6 in the final of the Jindal Polo Estate Cup on Sunday.

item.title: Australia Add Uncapped Duo Trenaman, Brown To Squad For One-off Test Against India
item.description: New South Wales: Australia have called up uncapped pair Rachel Trenaman and Maitlan Brown to their squad for one-off Test against India, that commences at the WACA Ground in Perth on March 6.

item.title: Federico Cina Wins MahaOpen ATP Challenger 75 Men’s Tennis C’ship
item.description: Maharashtra State Lawn Tennis Association: Sixth seed Federico Cina produced a stunning comeback under pressure to defeat Britain’s Felix Gill 6-3, 5-7, 7-6(1) and lift the MahaOpen ATP Challenger 75 Men’s Tennis Championship at the Shiv Chhatrapati Kreeda Sankul, Mhalunge Balewadi Tennis Stadium on Sunday.

item.title: T20 WC: Samson Showed His Full Potential When The Team Needed Him The Most, Says Gambhir
item.description: After Sanju Samson: After Sanju Samson struck an unbeaten 97 to guide India into the Men’s T20 World Cup semi-final after a five-wicket victory over the West Indies at Eden Gardens, head coach Gautam Gambhir lauded him for stepping up when the team needed him the most to make big runs.

item.title: Arsenal Beat Chelsea To Stay 5 Points Clear In Premier League
item.description: Premier League: William Saliba and Jurrien Timber both scored from corner kicks as Arsenal beat Chelsea 2-1 at the Emirates Stadium to retain its five-point lead at the top of the Premier League.

item.title: T20 WC: 'Switched Off Phone and Social Media, Listened To Myself,' Says Samson After Hitting Unbeaten 97
item.description: T20 World Cup Super Eight: India opener Sanju Samson said he switched off his phone and social media to listen to himself and protect his self-belief during a lean patch, which ended with his match-winning 97 in the Men’s T20 World Cup Super Eight clash against the West Indies on Sunday.

item.title: 'We're Safe; Govt, WFI Assured Us We Won’t Face Any Difficulty': Chief Coach Virender Singh After Women Wrestlers Stranded In Albania
item.description: Most West Asian: Indian women wrestling team has been stranded in Tirana, Albania, as the escalating Israel-Iran conflict severely disrupted the flight schedules. However, the Indian government and the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI) promptly arranged accommodation for the team in the Albanian capital.

item.title: India To Host Afghanistan For One-off Test, Three ODIs In June: BCCI
item.description: BRSABV Ekana Cricket Stadium: Afghanistan will tour India for a one-off Test and three ODIs in June, said the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) on Monday. The series, to be held soon after the 2026 Indian Premier League (IPL) ends, will mark Afghanistan’s first bilateral series against India after their last face-off happened via a three-game T20I series in January 2024.
